infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Solunivo shows the calendars from your Calendar app next to your Google calendars and lets you edit their events here. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Solunivo shows the calendars from your Calendar app next to your Google calendars and lets you edit their events here. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Solunivo suggests people from your Contacts when you invite someone to an event and shows their birthdays in your calendar. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Solunivo uses your location only to show nearby results when you search for an event's location.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Solunivo shows your Reminders next to your calendar and lets you edit them here. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Solunivo shows your Reminders next to your calendar and lets you edit them here. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Solunivo transcribes what you say into an event entirely on this device.

plugins.microphonePermission: Solunivo uses the microphone to turn what you say into an event. Audio is transcribed on your device and never uploaded.
